_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Electronic Cost Reporting and Financial Tracking (eCRAFT) Report
summary: This DID establishes requirements for contractors to submit the Electronic Cost Reporting and Financial Tracking (eCRAFT) Report, covering labor, travel, materials, and other direct cost data.
use_relationship:
This DID establishes the requirements for the submission of the Electronic Cost Reporting and Financial Tracking (eCRAFT) Report by contractors. The eCRAFT Report is a critical deliverable that ensures compliance with mission to enhance contract management, surveillance, and reporting by leveraging authoritative data and automated tools. This initiative aims to standardize processes, improve decision-making, streamline compliance, and ensure cost control and oversight.

The eCRAFT Report provides detailed tracking of contractor expenditures for labor, materials, travel, subcontractor usage, and other direct costs (ODCs). It supports the Contracting Officer Representative (COR), Technical Point of Contact (TPOC), and acquisition personnel in monitoring contract performance, ensuring cost control, and facilitating compliance with Department of Defense (DoD) specific requirements.

This framework applies to issued contracts, specifically for cost plus fixed fee (CPFF), cost plus award fee (CPAF), and cost plus incentive fee (CPIF) level of effort (LOE) requirements and applies to contracts with at least one or more cost type labor contract line item numbers (CLINs). It excludes standalone firm fixed price (FFP) contracts.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

references.label: Product Data Reporting and Evaluation Program (PDREP)

distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The eCRAFT Report shall be submitted electronically in XML format, generated using:

children.title: The eCRAFT System Periodic Report Utility (ePRU)
Contractor accounting systems capable of generating XML files compliant with eCRAFT standards
Report Upload Reference
children.content: The XML file must be uploaded via the PDREP website (available at: Product Data Reporting and Evaluation Program (PDREP), https://www.pdrep.csd.disa.mil/pdrepweb/ecraft). For questions or assistance, contractors may contact the PDREP Help Desk via email at webptsmh@navy.mil or by phone at (207) 438-1690. Access to the website requires:

children.title: A valid Department of Defense (DoD) Common Access Card (CAC) or External Certificate Authority (ECA)
Appropriate permissions for uploading XML files

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The eCRAFT Report shall include the following:

children.title: Task Order Number
children.content: Identifier for the specific task order.

children.title: Vendor Report POC
children.content: Name and contact information of the contractor's point of contact.

children.title: Commitments and Comments
children.content: Any relevant notes or commitments from the contractor.

children.title: CLIN/SLIN
children.content: Contract Line Item Number or Sub-Line Item Number.

children.title: CAGE Code
children.content: Contractor's Commercial and Government Entity code.

children.title: Labor Category
children.content: Title and code of the labor category.

children.title: Employee Name
children.content: Name of the individual performing the work.

children.title: Site
children.content: Work location (e.g., government site, contractor site).

children.title: Burdened Labor Cost
children.content: Total labor cost including overhead and fees.

children.title: CLIN/SLIN
children.content: Contract Line Item Number or Sub-Line Item Number.

children.title: CAGE Code
children.content: Contractor's Commercial and Government Entity code.

children.title: Burdened Travel Cost
children.content: Total travel cost including overhead and fees.

children.title: CLIN/SLIN
children.content: Contract Line Item Number or Sub-Line Item Number.

children.title: CAGE Code
children.content: Contractor's Commercial and Government Entity code.

children.title: Quantity and Unit Cost
children.content: Number of units and cost per unit.

children.title: Burdened Material Cost
children.content: Total material cost including overhead and fees.

children.title: CLIN/SLIN
children.content: Contract Line Item Number or Sub-Line Item Number.

children.title: CAGE Code
children.content: Contractor's Commercial and Government Entity code.

children.title: Burdened ODC Cost
children.content: Total ODC cost including overhead and fees.

children.title: Invoice Period Start and End Dates
Summary
children.content: The eCRAFT Report is a critical deliverable for all issued contracts with cost-type service/supply CLINs, including CPFF, CPAF, and CPIF LOE requirements. It ensures accurate, real-time financial tracking and reporting, facilitates compliance with DoD specific requirements, and supports data-driven decision-making for contract management and surveillance.
